sets.why: The quotient is the answer to a division problem: 6.

sets.q: Which words name two operations that undo each other, like × and ÷?
sets.why: Multiplication and division are inverse operations: 6 × 7 = 42, so 42 ÷ 7 = 6.
no: The dividend is the number being divided.
The quotient is the answer to division.

sets.q: Tuffnut says 63 ÷ 9 = 8. Which fact proves him wrong?
no: Subtracting one 9 does not check his answer.

sets.q: Which fact solves 64 ÷ 8? Finish it: 8 × ____ = 64
Which sentence uses allot correctly?
choices: Astrid will allot 9 apples to each rider.
Snotlout will allot his helmet onto his head.
Fishlegs will allot the eggs to see how many there are.
Hiccup will allot a new tail fin for Toothless.
sets.why: To allot is to give each person or group a certain share: 9 apples for each rider.
no: Putting on a helmet is not giving out shares.
That is counting. Allot means to give out shares.
Building something is not giving out shares.

sets.q: The crew had only a little water left, so the captain gave each sailor one cup a day to make it last. He chose to ____ the water. (Use a word from your word cards.)
sets.why: To ration is to give out small, set amounts so supplies last.

sets.q: Which of these would a Viking crew pack as provisions for a long voyage?
sets.why: Provisions are supplies of food and other needed things, packed for later.
no: A name is not a supply you can pack.
A song is not food or supplies.
The mast is part of the ship, not provisions.

sets.no: Use the ×6 shortcut: 5 × 9 = 45, plus one more 9.

sets.q: Gobber will allot the swords among his students. Which word means almost the same as allot?
sets.why: To allot is to give each person a certain share.
no: Hiding keeps the swords away from everyone.
Sharpening fixes the swords. It does not share them.
Borrowing means taking something for a while.

sets.q: When food runs low, a smart chief will ____ it, handing out small, set amounts each day. (Use a word from your word cards.)
sets.why: To ration is to give out small, set amounts so supplies last.
